# Fresh transfer and delayed retries
First attempt these without reference answers after explained repair. Teacher may change examples again to preserve independence. Record original work, cause and fresh evidence; no new summative assessment.
T1 Python: totals [[2,0,1],[1,1,0]], then [] and ragged [[1],[1,2]]. Create independent zero rows, change one cell and explain the result. Trace binary search [2,5,8,11,14,17] for16; compare to a linear search of unsorted records. Sort [('A',2),('B',1),('C',2)] by numeric key and explain equal-key order.
T2 Objects: capacity1 Session, reserve once, then again; define a new subclass OutdoorSession.location->'Outdoor', and use the same call loop. Explain why directly assigning `_booked` bypasses intended methods and why actual authorisation requires other logic.
T3 SQL: fresh seed; add L05,R04,M02,2026-10-03,NULL. Predict both reports. Then fresh seed, add a second inspection for R01; explain why joining both child collections multiplies R01 loan rows. Design preaggregation rather than applying DISTINCT blindly.
T4 Network: fresh192.168.70.0/24 for70hosts and20hosts, largest first. Give subnet details, avoid overlap and explain default gateway/next-hop roles. Compare a wrong gateway with a DNS failure using discriminating evidence.
T5 Case: an established eligible federal breach is supplied for the covered private provider, with no effective remedial prevention and no notification exception. Compare actions with a mere suspicious export log. Then remove the entity/date assumption: list what must be established before choosing a framework. Explain why a secure connection does not grant a learner all-record export.
T6 Mixed response (~20minutes, original formative): learner database report has a missing zero-loan resource, the code counts None as attendance0, guest policy permits any internal traffic, and a manager cites HTTPS as proof of export permission. Identify one cause/evidence/repair per issue, then justify a second test that could falsify the proposed repair. No automated score establishes legal compliance or full-course readiness.
Delayed retry at least a later lesson: use another changed example in each selected priority, without answers. Revisit remaining gaps in Weeks15–16 preparation; not an extra deadline.
